summary: @servicetitan/acquisition-functions preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex identifiers, string-substitution) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts and chmod +x's the binary, then invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated module (hex variable names, rotated string-array via a shuffle function, no plaintext URLs; marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` so it only runs under Bun, not Node) whose network destinations and behavior are reconstructed at runtime from the encoded array. The dist/ directory contains readable MongoDB filter-converter library code consistent with the advertised purpose; the obfuscated preinstall + Bun-only payload pair is unrelated to that purpose and is added on top of it. The package is published under the `@servicetitan/` scope, presenting as an internal ServiceTitan artifact. Installing the package causes the Bun-executed obfuscated payload to run on the installer's machine with the user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
